text: ポケモンを　そだてて　いくと　わざを　おぼえる！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　そだてて　いくと

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form says the action keeps going on from now. そだてていく = 'go on raising them'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that when the first thing happens, the next naturally follows. そだてていくと = 'when you keep raising them'.
